_about: John Percival Postgate (1853-1926), Latinist. English essays, and his Lucan editions with English introduction and notes (Latin text). His Loeb Tibullus is held on the catullus shelf. Latin-text editions without English apparatus (Corpus Poetarum Latinorum, the Propertius and Catullus texts) not taken. Round dx (2026-10-23) added, raw IA OCR with title pages read: The New Latin Primer (Cassell, 1888); Select Elegies of Propertius (Macmillan, 1919 printing; first printed 1881); Selections from Tibullus and others (Macmillan, 1903); Sermo Latinus, new and enlarged edition (Macmillan, 1913); Translation and Translations (G. Bell, 1922); A Short Guide to the Accentuation of Ancient Greek (Hodder and Stoughton, 1924).

postgate-dead-language-1910: Dead Language and Dead Languages, with special reference to Latin (Liverpool inaugural lecture, 1910)
